nih_official_split_mapping_policy.description: NIH provides official train_val_list.txt (86,524 images) and test_list.txt (25,596 images, 100% disjoint patient IDs). In this project, the official test_list.txt patients are frozen strictly for held-out testing, while train_val_list.txt patients are partitioned into disjoint train (87.5% of train_val) and validation (12.5% of train_val) sets, preserving complete patient isolation.

train.description: Primary parameter optimization partition. Positive class weights (pos_weight) for BCEWithLogitsLoss are computed strictly from this partition.

validation.description: Hyperparameter tuning, early stopping, and operating threshold optimization partition. Never used for gradient updates.

test.description: Frozen held-out test partition matching official NIH test patient cohort. Evaluated strictly once after all thresholds and weights are frozen.
